key_result: Herd- and arbitrage-dominated markets of equal size have identical return distributions and turnover, yet stress episodes differ in length; maker-taker pricing, not a uniform fee, restores stability.
takeaway: Analyses the feedback that learning trading agents create on a constant-product automated market maker.
title: Learning AI Agents, Market Makers, and Stress in Automated Markets
why_it_matters: It argues that common risk rules cannot tell herd-driven from arbitrage-driven markets apart.
